name: Lehmer's totient problem
target: phi(n) | n - 1 implies n is prime
result: Open. The bound omega(n) >= 16 is proved (control lehmer-omega-16); the final analytical pass of 21 October 2026 added two constraints on the divisor D and no route to the conjecture.
barriers: the assertion equivalent to the conjecture (Proposition 9.1 of eLhmr): for no finite set S of odd primes and M >= 2 is 1 + (A - 1)/(M B - A) a prime above S; the known tools bound the number and size of solutions, not one coincidence
the constraints that follow from the algebra, (q - 1) D = A - 1 and D odd with D = -A mod 2^|S|, are congruences and cannot force a number never to be prime
sixteen primes: about 9 x 10^13 two-prime problems, a million times the fifteen-prime case, for one more unit of the bound

notes.human: the equivalent assertion and the constraints on D are in Section 9 of the journal version; the engine checks them in construct/lehmer_equiv.py
